findings.summary: Scroll-reveal motion ignores the reduced-motion preference.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, found no reduced-motion CSS rule, and the six content cards retained opacity/transform transitions controlled by IntersectionObserver.
findings.suggestedFix: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove transform/transition effects and reveal content immediately; do not make readable content depend on a motion callback.

findings.summary: Navigation and long-page orientation use abrupt, static behavior rather than modern state-aware cues.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probes found no View Transition, scroll-state, progress, sticky orientation, highlight, or scroll-marker implementation on a 13,498px-tall page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight contents navigation and scroll-position cue; use progressive View Transitions or highlight effects for route and in-page navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The advertised primary discovery task is not available on the audited page.
findings.evidence: The page tells users to use a search bar and browse categories, but the DOM probe found zero forms and only eight links. Both “View Full Site” CTAs point back to the same canonical homepage with tracking parameters rather than a search or catalogue flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose the real catalogue/search as the primary action, or rewrite the promise as an honest informational guide. Remove the circular “View Full Site” CTA and provide category links that complete the stated task.

findings.summary: Redirect and render-blocking work delay an otherwise small page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured mobile LCP 2.6s and identified ~840ms redirect savings, ~920ms render-blocking savings, a font-display delay, and 14KiB unused CSS. HAR recorded the initial 301 and a render path containing the CDN stylesheet/font.
findings.suggestedFix: Link directly to the canonical host, remove Font Awesome for two icons or subset/self-host it, ensure font-display is non-blocking, and delete unused CSS.

findings.summary: Two links use non-descriptive “Click Here” text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO scored 0.92 and its link-text audit identified two links; the DOM confirms both are labelled only “Click Here”.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace each label with destination-specific text, such as “Open the FilmyFly guide in this tab”, and avoid duplicating the same destination beside the main CTA.

findings.summary: The canonical page omits CSP and HSTS.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirmed HTTPS, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, strict-origin-when-cross-origin and a restrictive Permissions-Policy, but reported Content-Security-Policy and Strict-Transport-Security missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive Content-Security-Policy (prefer external scripts/styles or nonces/hashes) and HSTS after confirming all subdomains are HTTPS-ready.

findings.summary: Unknown routes do not provide a useful recovery page to the tested client.
findings.evidence: A direct request to /nonexistent-audit-route produced a Cloudflare “Just a moment” challenge/403 surface rather than a branded not-found page with navigation or recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status with a lightweight branded recovery page, useful links, and no unnecessary bot challenge for ordinary navigation.

findings.summary: Several mobile text links have undersized touch targets.
findings.evidence: At 360px, the target probe measured both “Click Here” links at 17px high and footer links at 27.2px high, below a comfortable 44px touch target, although primary CTAs were 55.2px high and keyboard outlines remained visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Add block-level padding and spacing so all actionable links provide approximately 44 by 44 CSS pixel hit areas without changing their visual text size.

findings.summary: Logo images use legacy PNG delivery without responsive alternatives.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found two PNG images, no modern formats and no srcset; Lighthouse estimated about 15KiB image-delivery savings. Dimensions, lazy loading and alt text were otherwise correct.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP variants where beneficial and provide srcset/sizes for the header logo while retaining explicit dimensions.
